question.worked_solution:
First, we take the derivative of each term and then add them:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}\,(4\operatorname{sec}⁡x+{e}^{x}) \\  & =4\operatorname{sec}⁡x\operatorname{tan}⁡x+{e}^{x}\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we substitute $x=0$:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}{|}_{x=0} & =(4\operatorname{sec}⁡x\operatorname{tan}⁡x+{e}^{x})\,{|}_{x=0} \\  & =4\operatorname{sec}⁡(0)\operatorname{tan}⁡(0)+{e}^{0} \\  & =4\cdot 1\cdot 0+1 \\  & =1\end{aligned}
$$
